title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting EU cities’ candidacies to host a new United Nations pillar for the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI
part_text: ‘Considers the EU to be well placed to host UN structures on AI, given its institutional capacity, scientific expertise and commitment to promoting a human-centric, safe and trustworthy approach to AI governance;  welcomes, in this regard, existing UN structures and initiatives within the EU, including the United Nations AI Governance for Humanity Lab, under the United Nations Office for Digital and Emerging Technologies; welcomes proposals to host initiatives within the EU, including proposals for a UN pillar dedicated to the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI and for a UN AI safety and governance centre;’
